name: Visual Complexity (VC) Algorithm
definition: A nonphotorealistic visualization method that places every data element in a single region S0, then applies a painting algorithm with full coverage to create a list of strokes, varying stroke properties (color, size, aspect ratio, contour, contrast) as the list is created to simulate hand-painted visual complexity.
summary: The Visual Complexity algorithm is a non-photorealistic volume rendering technique that simulates hand-painted local variations using full-coverage strokes and embossing, distinct from global trend methods or structured hatching.
